{{< include ../_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

This page uses WebAssembly runtimes. The first visit may take a few seconds
while the browser downloads Python or R. Edit either cell and select
**Run Code**.

## Python with Pyodide

```{pyodide}
values = [2, 4, 6, 8]
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
```

## R with WebR

```{webr}
values <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
mean(values)
```

## Plotting in Python

```{pyodide}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = [1, 2, 3, 4]
y = [1, 4, 9, 16]
plt.plot(x, y, marker="o")
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("x squared")
plt.show()
```
